clips.hook: KreekCraft's GTA 6 pitch to a mom
clips.title: A viewer's mom asked KreekCraft what GTA 6 is about… his answer is perfect
clips.caption: Someone's mom asked what GTA 6 is about and KreekCraft gave the most wholesome answer possible 😂
clips.voice_intro: Halfway up a radio tower, KreekCraft gets asked to explain GTA 6 to someone's mom.
clips.voice_outro: Rescuing cats and finding grandma's car keys. That's the most innocent GTA pitch ever, and the mom might actually buy it.

clips.hook: He climbed all the way up for this
clips.title: KreekCraft climbed a giant tower in GTA 6 because chat promised an Easter egg
clips.caption: Chat promised an Easter egg at the top. KreekCraft had questions 🗼
clips.voice_intro: Chat swore there's a secret at the top of this tower. KreekCraft is about to find out.
clips.voice_outro: That whole climb, his stream on the line, and the first thing he finds is a parachute. Chat either trolled him or hid something good.
